description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing 'Article' entities within the Coocook project. It includes actions for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting articles, as well as private helper methods for fetching related data and handling complex operations like associating tags and units.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Article
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing articles, including CRUD operations and related data handling.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list articles, fetching project data, articles, and associated units, and preparing data for the view.

methods.name: new_article
methods.description: Displays the form for creating a new article.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method to fetch and stash an article by ID, or detach with not_found if absent.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for an existing article, including units in use.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new article, detaching to update_or_insert.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing article, detaching to update_or_insert.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an article if not used in dishes or recipes, otherwise returns a bad request error.

methods.name: fetch_project_data
methods.description: Private method to fetch default project-related data such as shelf life, preorder info, shop sections, and units.

methods.name: dishes_recipes
methods.description: Collects related recipes linked to dishes and independent dishes, preparing data for the view.

methods.name: update_or_insert
methods.description: Handles the logic for updating or inserting an article, including validation, setting tags, units, and related data.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the articles index page.
